mechanism.claim: A completed eight-hour BTC block whose realized path variation greatly exceeds a fixed heterogeneous multi-scale forecast is a volatility innovation. When the block and its final two hours agree directionally and the full path converts variation into displacement efficiently, the innovation represents directional price discovery rather than two-way churn and should continue for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVHVS uses a fixed HAR-style forecast from lagged block, daily, and weekly variation scales and ranks the current forecast innovation. Variance-acceleration candidates compare adjacent halves; temporal ignition uses within-block concentration; directional-persistence candidates use implied-volatility levels. HVHVS uses no implied volatility, flow, volume, funding, OI, cross-assets, prior event rows, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: a top-quartile positive realized-variation forecast surprise directly identifies an unexpectedly volatile regime
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC forecast-innovation onsets with an eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute close-to-close log returns), strict positive
features.har_forecast: arithmetic mean of prior block RV, mean of three strictly prior block RVs, and mean of twenty-one strictly prior block RVs; all 21 prior exact valid blocks required; current excluded
features.variation_surprise: log(current realized variation / HAR forecast), strict positive
features.surprise_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid positive surprises, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.path_efficiency: abs(block_return)/sum absolute one-minute close-to-close returns, strict positive
features.efficiency_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.60
features.direction_confirmation: block and late returns have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed heterogeneous multi-scale realized-variation forecast innovation

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
